purpose: Score the paste-consistent expanded candidate once, PNG-only, on the prospective grouped validation split (387 val records in 361 groups), sealing every prediction before the first GT read. No training, no inference and no GT read is authorized by this recipe.

parent_grants_required: grouped_train/split.json present and frozen with the expected counts
candidate checkpoint finished with config.mask_target_projection=paste_consistent and the pinned update count
explicit grant for one PNG-only batch, one seal and one CPU score (--allow-gt)
authorization.note: The parent accepted the measured crop/full improvement of the paste-consistent candidate as the reason to continue with enlarged training; this recipe does not re-run any completed candidate stage.

objective.primary: strict instance recall TP/(TP+FN) > 0.90 on the 387-record grouped validation split, same-class, strict IoU > 0.5, Hungarian one-to-one
objective.canonical_pq: PQ/SQ/RQ from cadvec.recognition_raster_data.score_documents, canonical 100 canvas / 1000 raster / 1 px stroke, Thing instance -1 skipped, Stuff merged per class
forbidden_claims: coverage or recall of the official test_final / dev_final / eval_pool split
a pristine held-out result (prior exposure of these records is uncertain)
comparison with the FloorPlanCAD PanCADNet vector baseline (PQ 0.561) or any vector-IoU number
an overall project goal is met

split.owner: the grouped split owner, outside this lane

expected.record_positions: immutable original-position arrays into the expanded record index, one array per side, written once by the split owner; this recipe does not define their field names, it verifies counts, disjointness and digests at preflight

expanded_store.datasets_root: taken from the expanded manifest's own datasets_root field, never re-derived or guessed
expanded_store.access_api: outputs/recognition-expanded-fit-20261114-01/scripts/expanded_record_store.py: ExpandedRecordStore for indexed records and record_paths(record, datasets_root) for the png/svg pair
must_not: invent a record_paths object or mapping schema inside the manifest
open a PNG or an SVG while building inputs

position_map.role: original manifest record positions of the trained subset, written by the same trainer step

must_bind: checkpoint identity: path, bytes, sha256 and the terminal train_report the trainer wrote
frozen split identity: split path, sha256, seed 20261108, the four counts
trained positions: the record positions and group ids used for training, or their digest plus counts
grouped_train_receipt.why: the model ABI does not record the split inside config: payload['config'] carries mask_target_projection and detector settings only, so the split identity cannot be read from the checkpoint and must come from this receipt

reserve_selection.rule: a formerly reserve-role group is the validation holdout exactly when int(sha256(f'20261108:{group_id}').hexdigest(), 16) % 10000 < 1000
not_applied_to: any other role, group or record
reserve_selection.fit_rule: every source_role == 'fit' group is training, unconditionally

measured.source: manifest/expanded_train_manifest.json counts plus a metadata-only pass over manifest/expanded_train_records.jsonl

reads: future grouped_train/split.json (metadata: counts, seed, group ids, original record positions)
manifest/expanded_train_records.jsonl (record metadata only, via the expanded record store)
must_not_read: any PNG pixel or SVG content
algorithm: let lane_root be the resolved <lane>; require the split path to be <lane>/grouped_train/split.json and to exist
load the split metadata; require seed 20261108 and train.records/train.groups/val.records/val.groups equal 3366/3167/387/361
take the val record positions in the split's own recorded order; do not sort, shuffle or resample
resolve each val record through the expanded record store index and call record_paths(record, datasets_root) for its png_path (and svg_path when present); no path is assembled by hand
require every val group to contribute all of its members; a partial group is refused as inputs_group_partial
include all 387 records, including every extra record that shares a group id with another val record; repeated group ids are expected and allowed
refuse duplicate sample ids as inputs_duplicate (the same code instance_eval.contract.normalize_inputs raises), so the 387 inputs are unique by sample id
require each png_path to exist, to end in .png, and to avoid sealed tokens (test_final/dev_final/eval_pool/reserve/.runtime)
write the shared inputs object {schema: cadvec.direct_instance.inputs.v1, samples: [...]} to the inputs path and record its sha256 and count
verify 387 unique sample ids and 361 distinct group ids, and record the model order as the frozen holdout order

acceptance_of_repeated_groups.rule: normalize_inputs enforces uniqueness for sample_id only and passes group_id through unchanged, so an explicit inputs JSON with 361 groups over 387 records is accepted while a duplicated sample id is refused; no select_inputs count guard applies to an explicit inputs list

payload.shape: object {schema, samples: [{sample_id, group_id, record_index, position, png_path, svg_path}], split, manifest, multi_record_groups}
consumed_by: evaluation/instance_eval/contract.py normalize_inputs (reads samples, uniqueness on sample_id only, group_id passed through)

reads: the candidate checkpoint bytes (sha256 only; no torch load unless --strict-reload) and its train_report.json

checks.rule: the split sha256 in the grouped training receipt equals the sha256 of the frozen split file and the receipt's seed and four counts match the file

the checkpoint bytes and sha256 named by the grouped training receipt equal the candidate checkpoint, and the receipt's split identity and trained positions are the ones checked below; no split field is read from the checkpoint config because the model ABI does not record one
the trained record positions and trained group ids in the grouped training receipt are disjoint from the 387 val record positions and the 361 val group ids
the inputs builder produced exactly 387 records covering exactly the split's val record set, with 361 distinct groups and no partial group
checkpoint config.mask_target_projection == 'paste_consistent' (a missing key means legacy and is refused)
the terminal train_report records optimizer_steps == 8415 with accumulate 2, i.e. 16830 micro-batches = 5 passes over the 3366 training records; any other count is refused
the grouped training receipt reports the run terminal with checkpoint bytes/sha256 equal to the candidate checkpoint and no stage output already exists without a verified receipt

preflight.on_failure: stop before stage 1; write the preflight receipt and change nothing else

stages.name: grouped_val387_native_1000_predictions
reads: 387 PNGs named by the inputs JSON
guards: PNG-only: a non-.png or .svg input is refused (batch_png_required)
existing outputs are refused before the checkpoint is loaded (predictions_exist)
exactly one checkpoint load for the whole batch (checkpoint_loads == 1)
official config thresholds and max detections are reused, no tuning

stages.name: seal_all_387_predictions
guards: every one of the 387 predictions must exist and validate first (missing_prediction / prediction_invalid)
each prediction is hashed and its sha256 recorded
the seal records gt_read=false, svg_read=false, png_read=false
the seal refuses an existing seal or a directory outside the lane
stages.ordering: the seal is the last artifact written before any ground-truth read

stages.name: score_grouped_val387
reads: ground truth built once from the inputs' svg_path
guards: re-verifies every prediction hash and the seal before the first GT read
reads GT exactly once, per sample, and never re-derives or caches it

comparison.against: the paste-consistent candidate's exposed FIT16 numbers only as context, never as a held-out baseline
rules: report TP/FP/FN, SumIoU, PQ, SQ, RQ, recall, precision, F1 with explicit nulls on empty denominators
report Thing vs Stuff and per-class rows
report the per-image hit list and keep empty-GT images with recall null
do not average or compare across protocols (vector entity IoU vs this pixel raster proxy)

scope.label: grouped-val387-prospective
scope.intended_reading: prospective grouped holdout on a directly trained expanded run
scope.prior_exposure_reason: the 387 val records come from formerly reserve-role groups that earlier fit/tune/eval-pool stages and earlier fine-tunes could have reached, so prior exposure cannot be excluded from metadata alone
claims_allowed: prospective grouped split created by an independent seed-20261108 group split
direct expanded run scored with the canonical pixel-raster proxy
diagnostic of generalisation on groups withheld from the expanded training split
prior exposure of individual records is uncertain
claims_forbidden: never seen during training or tuning

current_evaluator_behaviour.role_mapping: evaluation/instance_eval/evaluator.py _scope_role maps a dataset label containing 'fit' to role fit, 'tune'/'fixed4' to role tune, otherwise 'unspecified'; the label 'grouped-val387-prospective' therefore yields role 'unspecified'
current_evaluator_behaviour.heldout_flag: evaluator._scope_claim always writes heldout=false and a 'diagnostic, not a pristine held-out result' claim
current_evaluator_behaviour.consequence: the seal and report are honest today, but they cannot express a verified prospective holdout; no held-out claim may be read from the dataset label alone

required_fields.split_sha256: digest of the frozen split, equal to the receipt's record
required_fields.trained_positions_sha256: position map digest, matching the grouped receipt and disjoint from the val positions
required_fields.checkpoint_binding: the checkpoint sha256 named by the grouped receipt and by its train_report
required_fields.seal_samples: the seal's 387 sample ids equal the frozen holdout order

verification: the grouped train receipt, the position map, the split, the manifest and the records index all still hash to the values the receipt recorded
the trained positions and groups are disjoint from the 387 val records and 361 val groups
the seal lists exactly the frozen holdout samples and records gt_read/svg_read/png_read as false
provenance.effect: the provenance object reports this direct run as a prospective grouped holdout beside the evaluator report; the evaluator's own scope block keeps heldout=false and is not modified for a dataset label
provenance.effect_when_unverified: status refused with the failing checks; no prospective holdout reading is offered and no held-out claim is made

claims.allowed: prospective grouped holdout for this direct run; historical exposure of the expanded images is uncertain
claims.forbidden: pristine, never seen, vector-baseline comparable, overall goal met

remaining_blockers: <lane>/grouped_train/split.json exists and is frozen (seed 20261108, 3366/3167 train and 387/361 holdout); it is re-verified, never rebuilt, by the inputs builder

<lane>/runs/grouped_expanded_paste_consistent01/grouped_train_receipt.json and grouped_position_map.json do not exist yet, so the checkpoint-to-split binding cannot be verified until the grouped training run completes
no grouped candidate checkpoint exists at <lane>/runs/grouped_expanded_paste_consistent01/checkpoint.pt
grouped_execution/ implements inputs, preflight, the staged runner and provenance, but no stage may run until the parent authorizes it after training completes
non_goals: no training, inference, GPU work or scoring in this recipe
no read of grouped_train files before they exist
no read of test_final / dev_final / eval_pool / .runtime
no modification of shared evaluator contracts or guards
no re-run of the completed FIT16 candidate stages

score.0: report written and success.passed is true (target_met)
score.1: report written and success.passed is false (valid below_target score)
score.2: guard failure: no valid report, refused (score_exit)
score.rule: only the report decides the outcome; a 0 with a failed report or a 1 with a passed report is refused as score_exit_mismatch

execution.receipts: <lane>/grouped_execution/receipts/stage_<name>.json plus grouped_preflight.json and grouped_provenance.json, attempt-suffixed on retry, never overwritten
execution.no_gt_before_seal: batch writes every envelope, prepare seals them, and score is the only stage that may read ground truth and only with --allow-gt
